business_summary: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale, and service of semiconductor thermoelectric devices, and thermoelectric systems and components in China and internationally. The company offers semiconductor thermoelectric devices comprising single-stage thermoelectric refrigeration device, miniature thermoelectric refrigeration devices, multi-stage thermoelectric refrigeration devices, and thermoelectric devices, as well as thermal cycling, high-power refrigeration, single-hole refrigeration, flexible substrate, and other customized devices; thermoelectric systems, including condensing dehumidifiers, heat pipe silent systems, mattress systems, RC cycle refrigeration systems, fermentation tank systems, PCR amplification systems, energy storage dehumidification systems, air conditioning clothes systems, and other products; and thermoelectric complete unit application products, such as beer machines, constant temperature wine cabinets, thermostatic mattress, electronic refrigerators, milk freezing machines, ice cream machines, dehumidifiers, smart bathroom mirror cabinet, cigar cabinet, and air-conditioned clothing. It also engages in the manufacture of ceramic copper-clad substrates for semiconductor refrigeration, power electronic modules, semiconductor cooling substrates, COB flip-chip ceramic circuit boards, LED packaging and lighting, ceramic thick film substrates, automotive inverter systems, military and aerospace products, and other technological fields; and electronic components. In addition, the company provides services for smart wearables, new energy vehicles, and other related fields; and sales consulting services. Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.
business_summary_ko: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 반도체 열전 장치, 열전 시스템 및 부품의 연구, 설계, 개발, 제조, 판매 및 서비스에 참여합니다. 이 회사는 단일 스테이지 열전 냉동 장치, 소형 열전 냉동 장치, 다단계 열전 냉동 장치 및 열전 장치로 구성된 반도체 열전 장치뿐만 아니라 열 사이클링, 고전력 냉동, 단일 홀 냉동, 유연한 기판 및 기타 맞춤형 장치를 제공합니다. 응축 제습기, 히트 파이프 무음 시스템, 매트리스 시스템, RC 사이클 냉동 시스템, 발효 탱크 시스템, PCR 증폭 시스템, 에너지 저장 제습 시스템, 에어컨 의류 시스템 및 기타 제품을 포함한 열전 시스템; 맥주머신, 항온 와인캐비닛, 온도조절매트리스, 전자냉장고, 우유냉동기, 아이스크림머신, 제습기, 스마트욕실거울캐비닛, 시가캐비닛, 에어컨 등 열전완제품 응용제품
